guitar.evidence: Mikael Åkerfeldt has long-running, well-documented PRS signature guitar models, fairly well known in progressive metal gear circles.

tone.target: dark modern death-metal rhythm tone with tight palm-mute chug and lead-edge clarity
tone.profile: dark modern death-metal rhythm tone with tight palm-mute chug and lead-edge clarity
tone.summary: A highly aggressive signal chain utilizing a powerful distortion/high-gain preamp (RAT-style) followed by an 80s metal amp model (UK 800), paired with a robust 4x12 cabinet to achieve the tight, articulate death metal rhythm tone.
corrections: Replace fuzz with tight boosted distortion
Keep low end controlled, not rumbling

blocks.purpose: Eliminate hum and noise inherent in high-gain recording.
Provide a tight, aggressive boost for rhythm chugs and lead clarity (replacing the Tube Screamer clue).
blocks.gap: The Boost module is used to emulate the tightening effect of an OD pedal like a TS, focusing on mid-range punch without adding excessive grit.

alternatives.reason: If more classic overdrive character is desired.

blocks.purpose: Establish the core high-gain foundation required for death metal rhythm tones.
Provide a modern, aggressive high-gain platform suitable for metal genres.
blocks.gap: The UK 800 is chosen over Recti/Bellman to maintain the 'modern' feel while providing necessary aggression and clarity.

alternatives.reason: For a heavier, more saturated modern metal sound.

blocks.purpose: Provide a classic yet robust sounding cabinet foundation for the rhythm tone.
Tighten the low end and enhance mid-range clarity for articulate palm-muting.
blocks.gap: Using EQ 2 allows for more surgical frequency control needed to combat 'scooped mush' while maintaining punch.

blocks.purpose: Kept inactive to maintain maximum tightness and focus on rhythm clarity.
blocks.gap: Modulation is generally avoided in death metal chugging, but Chorus is included as a placeholder for potential lead work if needed.

blocks.purpose: Provide subtle rhythmic echo for lead lines without creating a 'heavy delay wash'.
blocks.gap: The settings are kept minimal to adhere to the 'near-dry' requirement.

blocks.purpose: Add minimal spatial depth without sounding 'big' or washed out.
blocks.gap: The mix is kept very low to prevent excessive wash, fulfilling the 'reduce reverb' correction.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet IR for better modern clarity and punch.

proposals.reason: Improve low-end definition and high-mid articulation for tight chugging.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased punch and clarity in palm mutes.
